# 1PageMe

1PageMe is a **completely free and open-source**, modern, high-performance resume builder. It features an **advanced WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) editor** that allows users to edit their resume directly on the page—just like Word or Google Docs—eliminating the frustration of filling out separate forms and switching between tabs to see a preview.

## Core Features

- **ATS-Friendly:** Templates designed to be easily parsed by Applicant Tracking Systems, ensuring your resume gets through to recruiters.
- **Advanced WYSIWYG Editor:** Edit text directly on the resume template. No separate input boxes or preview windows—what you edit is exactly what you get.
- **Intelligent Layouts:** Templates designed to perfectly fit a single page, with automated formatting.
- **AI-Powered Import:** Effortlessly bring in existing resume data via LLM-assisted parsing.
- **Dynamic Templates:** Modern, recruiter-tested designs including Standard, Modern, and Academic styles.
- **Local-First & Sync:** Seamless synchronization between local storage and a Neon-powered database.
- **PDF Export:** High-quality PDF generation for professional submission.
- **100% Free & Open Source:** No hidden fees, no subscriptions, and fully transparent code.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js (App Router)
- **Styling:** TailwindCSS 4 with @tailwindcss/typography
- **State Management:** Zustand
- **Database:** Neon (PostgreSQL) with Drizzle ORM
- **Authentication:** Custom JWT-based session management
- **Components:** Lucide React (icons), React Hot Toast (notifications)

## Key Routes

- `/`: SEO-optimized landing page.
- `/blog`: Career advice and resume writing tips.
- `/app`: The core resume builder and dashboard.
- `/api/resumes`: RESTful endpoints for resume persistence.
- `/api/auth`: Authentication and session management.

## Project Structure

- `app/`: Next.js application routes and layouts.
- `components/`: Reusable UI components, layout managers, and resume templates.
- `store/`: Zustand stores for local and server state sync.
- `lib/`: Utility functions, database clients, and validation logic.
- `types/`: TypeScript definitions for the core resume schema.
- `hooks/`: Specialized React hooks for application logic.

## Design Philosophy

The application prioritizes **speed**, **simplicity**, and **visual impact**. It avoids complex formatting controls, instead using intelligent defaults and spacing logic to ensure every resume looks great regardless of content volume.
